_comment: Real building: Red Hook Recreation Center (NYC Parks), BBL 3005820001. Public: LL84 2024 kWh and floor area; PLUTO says individual landmark (Red Hook Play Center, LP-2241, 2008) and year built 1936 (LL84 says 1920). Basement flooded in Hurricane Sandy (2012). Not public (stated choices): budget, roof area (PLUTO floor area, 1 floor), critical loads. roof_replaced_year left blank on purpose.
critical_loads: gym cooling, lighting and communications for a cooling center
question: Our rec center flooded in Hurricane Sandy and is used as a cooling center. How do we cut grid power 30% by 2030 and keep critical loads running in outages, on $750k?
